name: Clazolam
summary: Clazolam (SAH-1123), also referred to as isoquinazepon, is a drug which is a fused benzodiazepine and tetrahydroisoquinoline derivative. It was developed in the 1960s but was never marketed. It possesses anxiolytic effects and is also claimed to have antidepressant properties.

pharmacology.text: It possesses anxiolytic effects and is also claimed to have antidepressant properties.

uses.text: It was developed in the 1960s but was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, lead to dependence with dangerous withdrawal including seizures, and in overdose can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的苯二氮平類藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差與記憶問題，可能導致依賴，戒斷時可能出現包括癲癇發作在內的危險症狀，過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的苯二氮平类药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差与记忆问题，可能导致依赖，戒断时可能出现包括癫痫发作在内的危险症状，过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: Clazolam has an extra ring fused onto the benzodiazepine core, joining it to a tetrahydroisoquinoline, the same ring system found in many plant alkaloids.
fact.zh: Clazolam 在苯二氮平核心上多融合了一個環，與四氫異喹啉相連，而四氫異喹啉也是許多植物生物鹼的環系統。
fact.zhHans: Clazolam 在苯二氮平内核上多融合了一个环，与四氢异喹啉相连，而四氢异喹啉也是许多植物生物碱的环系统。
